subject: Request: evidence package for personnel controls (training, background & offboarding)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline-audit.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — personnel controls for SOC2 scope

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again — Brightline is kicking off the personnel controls review for Redwood's SOC2 scope. To complete our sampling we need the following artifacts covering employees and contractors who were active between 2026-07-01 and 2027-06-30:  

- Proof of security awareness training completion (date, employee id/email, module names)
- Background check attestations (redacted PII ok, HR reference id is sufficient)
- Standard joiner checklist (access assigned; accounts created) and leaver checklist (deprovisioning logs with timestamps)
- Any escrows or HR attestations for contractors whose onboarding differed from employees

Can you confirm whether you can provide CSV or spreadsheet exports for the roster and a sampling of redacted background attachments? Ideally delivered via a secure share (Drive link or DocuSign transfer). If you have any retention policies or redaction standards, please flag those so we can document our evidence notes.

Target turnaround for our sampling is next Tuesday, 20 Jul. If that’s tight, let me know a realistic earliest date.

Regards,
Priya Shah
Senior Auditor, Brightline Audit
priyaa.shah@brightline-audit.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: request_checklist.xlsx (stub)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline-audit.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel controls for SOC2 scope

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the roster CSV and redacted background PDFs. A few clarifying points before we compile:  

1) Scope: do you need contractor records for short-term contractors (<30 days) or only contractors with ongoing access >90 days?
2) Redaction standard: we’ll redact SSNs and DOBs but leave HR reference ids (e.g., HR-23547). Is that acceptable?
3) Offboarding evidence: we can provide IAM deprovisioning logs (timestamped) and ticket references from our HRIS. Do you prefer combined PDF export or separate CSV + log snippets?

We’ll prepare a preliminary package and put it in a secure Drive folder. I’ll also send a DocuSign transfer for the sensitive-file transfer consent (so legal has a record). The team expects to have the initial package by Mon, 19 Jul. If you need anything earlier, flag the highest-priority items.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Technical Partnerships (on behalf of Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

--
Attachment: consent_powerform_link.txt (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priyaa.shah@brightline-audit.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel controls for SOC2 scope

Priya — attaching the initial package per Jonas’ plan. Quick notes:  

- training_roster_Q2_2027.csv (includes employee email, role, completion date, module set). We export on an HRID basis; PII columns were removed for this transfer.
- background_checks_redacted_2027-07.pdf (sample of 25 completed background checks; each file has HR ref id at top, candidate name redacted, SSN/DOB redacted)
- onboarding_checklist_screenshots.zip (screenshots from HRIS showing steps ticked during joiner flow)

Retention/redaction policy: Redwood retains raw checks in our HRIS for 7 years; exported evidence is redacted to remove protected identifiers. Contractors: we included contractors with engagement >60 days; if you need <60-day folks, say so and we’ll pull.

Follow-ups: Neha (HR) is copied and can provide the HRIS export schema and ticket numbers for deprovisioning. Karthik — recommending we include a short attestation letter describing the redaction process; want me to draft?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success Ops (evidence coordination)
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

--
Attachments: training_roster_Q2_2027.csv; background_checks_redacted_2027-07.pdf; onboarding_checklist_screenshots.zip
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightline-audit.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel controls for SOC2 scope

Monica — thanks, we received the Drive link and downloaded the files. A couple of quick follow-ups from our sample review:  

- Redaction: HR reference ids are fine. Please add a one-line attestation (signed by HR) that the redaction was applied consistently and the raw (unredacted) artifacts are retained in the HRIS per your policy.
- Contractors: for 3 sampled contractor records it’s unclear whether the 90-day security orientation was completed. Could you confirm the policy for contractor security onboarding and provide evidence (completion flag or small export) for contractors with >60 days engagement?
- Deprovisioning logs: the IAM export shows ticket ids but not the triggering owner; can you map ticket -> owner (HR or manager) for the 8 sampled deprovisioning events? A simple CSV with ticket_id, owner, timestamp is sufficient.

If you can turn these three items around by EOD Thu, 22 Jul, that will keep us on schedule. If not, propose the earliest date.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Regards,
Priya Shah
Brightline Audit
